title: "My Novel" — Complete
author: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron
description: "My Novel" by Edward Bulwer-Lytton is a novel likely written during the early to mid-19th century.
longDescription: The story opens with a discourse among characters in Uncle Roland's tower, where the protagonist, Pisistratus, is urged to write a novel amidst discussions of history, population pressures, and social commentary on English rural life.

authorInfo.bio: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron (1803–1873) is the author of The Last Days of Pompeii. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
